# `team.get`

Show a team

Session-only, organization members. Renders members and repository grants.

- Method and path: `GET /{org}/-/teams/{team}`
- Scope: `repo:read`
- Kind: `read`
- CLI: `rukie team get`
- MCP: `team_get`
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | path | yes | `string` |
| `team` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`forbidden`, `not-found`, `unauthorized`, plus the framework problems.
